blocks.text: Leadership structure, reporting lines and accountability matrices
Cadence Financial Group  ·  Version 1.0  ·  Internal — Confidential

Cadence Financial Group is organised into five reporting divisions under the Chief Executive Officer. Governance of technology, data and risk activity is distributed across the Technology & Data and Risk, Compliance & Security divisions, with joint accountability recorded in the matrices that follow.
Client servicing, payments and shared services
Enterprise risk, compliance, privacy and assurance
Talent, workforce policy and employee relations

The General Counsel and the Data Protection Officer report directly to the Chief Executive Officer and hold a standing reporting line to the Board Risk Committee.

Committee interlock   The Chief Risk Officer chairs the Enterprise Risk Committee. The Data Protection Officer, the VP Information Security and the Director of Third-Party Risk hold standing membership. Escalations from the divisions feed the committee on a monthly cycle, with material items routed to the Board Risk Committee.

This pack carries an Internal — Confidential marking and holds directory-level personal data comprising names, corporate email addresses and mobile numbers.
Circulation is limited to named recipients with a defined business need. Onward forwarding, printing and upload to third-party or generative AI tools are to be avoided.
The role holder details shown are synthetic and have been generated for illustration. Live records are to be sourced from the HR system of record before operational use.
Superseded versions are to be withdrawn once a revised pack is issued; retention beyond the current reporting cycle is not anticipated.
